To the RIGHT a physically SEPARATE low rack with TWO plain closed candidate clean-water containers with light linen sealed ties, not automatically certified safe. A small pair of blank red/ochre booking ties attached to the SAME old barrel indicates competing bookings; do not clone barrel for each booking. Open ordinary paved land-return passage behind central stand, short-stay eaves in distance, no visible beds. No person testing by climbing, no drinking, washing or magically purifying barrel, no medical cross, no fulfilled delivery, infinite stock, repayment or authorship erased. Focus inspection and separated potential purposes, not another wine-storage cellar.
